profile.headline: Senior Instructional Designer | eLearning Developer | I really enjoy taking complex topics and making them accessible and easy for anyone to learn!
profile.summary:
Portfolio: 
www.moniquefwilliams.com

Book a Consultation:
https://calendly.com/moniquefwilliams

I am a Software Engineer turned Instructional Designer / eLearning Developer. I really enjoy taking complex topics and making them accessible and easy for almost anyone to learn! My ultimate goal is to immerse the user in a learning experience that was so well created, that they actually enjoy the process of learning!

* For 12 years I have found myself training others in some capacity.
* I have a natural gift for finding gaps and proposing the right solutions to solve them.

Experience
Applied Instructional Design Academy

Skills
Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Rise 360, Vyond: Video Animation, TechSmith Camtasia

positions.title: Learning Experience Designer
positions.description:
Project: Engineering Consulting Client
-Designed prompt engineering training content based on organizational learning objectives to equip employees with foundational knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) principles, best practices, and practical applications relevant to their job roles.
-Created engaging, learner-centered experiences that leveraged generative AI tools to successfully train 36,000+ employees to incorporate AI techniques into workflows across multiple departments.

Project: Nonprofit Client
-Developed and maintained the instructional integrity of self-paced eLearning courses focused on the government’s role in addressing structural racial inequities, achieving a 90% increase in learner confidence in equitable decision-making strategies, as reflected in post-training survey results.
-Evaluated learner performance using immersive storytelling and branching scenario-based assessments to measure proficiency in applying equity-focused decision-making frameworks.

Project: Banking Client
-Collaborated with business leaders and SMEs to design a suite of training materials, including eLearning courses, chat simulators, interactive PDFs, and job aids to equip bankers with the essential skills for effective qualitative lending analysis.
-Designed supplemental training resources such as infographics and animated training videos to enhance learner engagement and foster a stronger connection to the content, increasing retention and application.

Project: Nonprofit Client
-Produced a High Level Document, Detailed Design Document, Storyboard, and four animated video scripts to introduce the client’s approach to organization-level change for racial equity in a brief self-paced online learning module for racial equity practitioners in government agencies across the U.S.
-Ensured the module met WCAG 2.0 AA accessibility standards by incorporating closed captions, screen reader compatibility, and user-friendly navigation to promote equitable access for all learners.

positions.title: Senior Instructional Designer
positions.description:
-Led end-to-end design and development of comprehensive training for a high-priority Disputes Consent Order initiative, utilizing a data-driven approach by integrating QA dashboards into the design process and a learner-feedback polling strategy to ensure alignment with our customer service agent call center operational needs and regulatory requirements.
-Championed and secured leadership approval for a Gemini API integration initiative to automate L&D inventory maintenance; spearheaded the design and development of an AI-powered “Practice Coach” prototype in Articulate Storyline to enhance agent performance, feedback culture, and technology adoption.

positions.title: Instructional Design Consultant
positions.description:
-Conducted needs and gaps assessment to design a comprehensive learning program for the Employee Relations department, incorporating all-staff training on Sexual Harassment/Anti-Harassment policies and targeted coaching, guidance, and assessments for managers on Progressive Discipline and Effective Written Communication best practices.

-Utilized instructional design theory and the ADDIE model to develop eLearning courses, Virtual Instructor-Led Trainings (VILT) with detailed facilitator guides and targeted job aids, to effectively reduce post-training inquiries and alleviate the daily workload of the Employee Relations team.

positions.title: Instructional Designer
positions.description:
-Revamped onboarding curriculum, software simulations, and certification exams to train remote assistants on how to navigate a complex user interface to support autonomous driving vehicles.

-Integrated adult learning theories to create learner-centric content enriched with multimedia elements to foster engagement and facilitate a more immersive learning experience.
